description: This source file defines the Basket entity class within the eShopWeb application, representing a shopping basket with methods to add and remove items and manage the buyer ID.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with a collection of BasketItems, buyer ID, and methods to manipulate items.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Basket with a buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or updates the quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items from the basket that have a quantity of zero.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
